author: luna_seed_author
reviewNotes: The 2010–2014 dates are explicit. Article 24 applies Chinese law to marital property because the spouses’ common habitual residence is Beijing; Article 31 separately governs inheritance and Article 32 validates the form of a will if it complies with any listed connecting law, including the place where made (Korea). D confuses formal validity with substantive succession law. The analysis correctly preserves readyForApplication=false for unresolved estate-property classification and does not release the hold. Official law: https://cicc.court.gov.cn/html/1/218/62/83/442.html . Pair matches.
